summary: GraphRAG pairs knowledge graphs with large language models to produce trustworthy outputs. Language models have limited access to reliable data and can return inaccurate results; graph-powered retrieval goes beyond vector search by supplying context-rich, explainable answers at scale. The book covers how to model, build and apply knowledge graphs over structured and unstructured data, how to implement GraphRAG techniques that improve the accuracy and explainability of AI applications, and a broad set of retrieval patterns for agentic systems and advanced AI workflows. Co-written with Michael Hunger and Jesús Barrasa. An early release edition is available.
